title: How to Cancel Apple Music — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel Apple Music subscription on iPhone, Mac, or web. Stop the $10.99/mo charge and keep your library. All methods covered.
intro: Apple Music cancellation must be done through Apple's subscription settings — not through the Music app itself. The process differs slightly between iPhone, Mac, and web, but takes under 2 minutes on any platform.

steps.title: Open your Apple ID subscription settings
steps.text: On iPhone/iPad: Settings → tap your name → Subscriptions. On Mac: App Store → click your name → Account Settings → Subscriptions. On web: appleid.apple.com → Sign In → Subscriptions.
steps.tip: The fastest path on iPhone is: Settings → your name at the top → Subscriptions. Don't dig through the Music app.

steps.title: Find Apple Music in your subscription list
steps.text: Tap or click on Apple Music in your active subscriptions list. You'll see your current plan, price, and renewal date.

steps.title: Tap "Cancel Subscription" or "Cancel Free Trial"
steps.text: Scroll down and tap "Cancel Subscription" (red text). If you're on a free trial, it will say "Cancel Free Trial" instead. Apple will ask you to confirm.
steps.tip: Cancel before your trial ends to avoid being charged. Apple bills immediately when the trial period expires.

steps.title: Confirm cancellation
steps.text: Tap "Confirm" on the confirmation dialog. Your subscription remains active until the end of your current billing period. You'll see the expiration date on the confirmation screen.
steps.tip: Your downloaded music and playlists will become unplayable after expiration. Any music you purchased (bought, not streamed) from iTunes remains yours forever.

warnings: Downloaded Apple Music songs become unplayable after cancellation — they're DRM-protected streams, not purchases.
If you're on Apple One bundle, canceling Apple Music means canceling the entire bundle. Consider switching to individual services.
Your playlists and library are preserved for a period — if you re-subscribe within a few months, they'll be restored.
Family plan members all lose access if the family organizer cancels.

faqs.q: Will I lose my playlists if I cancel Apple Music?
faqs.a: Your playlists and library metadata are preserved by Apple for some time. If you re-subscribe, they should reappear. However, you cannot play any songs until you re-subscribe.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from Apple Music?
faqs.a: Apple offers refunds through reportaproblem.apple.com. You can request a refund for recent charges. They typically approve refunds for accidental renewals or if you cancel within a day of being charged.

faqs.q: What's the difference between canceling Apple Music and iTunes purchases?
faqs.a: Music you purchased from iTunes (bought individual songs/albums) is yours forever. Apple Music streaming content is only accessible while your subscription is active.

faqs.q: How do I cancel Apple Music on Android?
faqs.a: Open the Apple Music app on Android → tap the three dots menu → Account → Manage Subscription → Cancel Subscription. Or visit appleid.apple.com in a browser.

refund.details: Apple offers refunds through reportaproblem.apple.com. Request within 14 days of a charge for the best chance of approval. Free trial charges that you forgot to cancel before expiry are commonly refunded as a one-time courtesy.

retentionTactics: Apple may offer a discounted rate or extended free trial when you try to cancel.
They'll remind you of your library size and playlists you'll lose access to.
